note: This records what was measured. No defect is alleged by the existence of these numbers: cut_segment's -ss placement is frame-accurate under re-encoding in modern ffmpeg. The finding these measurements exist to prevent is drift going unnoticed, since a desynchronised clip is a valid file of the correct duration and every burned-in caption drifts with it.
